title: Northgate Reloadable Gift Card Loading Terms
content:
**Terms.** Only a Northgate Reloadable Gift Card, within the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program, can be reloaded, in its reload channels, by at least its smallest reload, at most its most reloads per day as counted by the number of reloads made on that card that calendar day, and never above its largest balance. Value can be loaded only on a card in issued, active or depleted status, the issued case being the initial load at issue and a reload on a depleted card making it active again.

## The status condition for loading value

- **What decides it.** The card's status in Northgate's own card record, not the customer's description of the card.
- **When it is read.** Before the value is loaded.
- **Which card.** The very card receiving the value, identified by its card record.

| Card status in the card record | Loading value |
|---|---|
| issued | the initial load at issue only |
| active | a reload is possible |
| depleted | a reload is possible, and the card becomes active again |
| frozen | not possible |
| expired | not possible |
| canceled | not possible |

## The daily reload count

The reloads counted toward the daily figure are the reloads made on the same card during the calendar day of the reload being evaluated. The initial load at issue and a balance transfer in are loads, but not reloads.

## Limits on one reload (stated against the card's own figures)

| Hypothetical reload | Within the terms? |
|---|---|
| exactly the smallest reload | yes |
| one cent below the smallest reload | no |
| bringing the balance to exactly the largest balance | yes |
| bringing the balance one cent above the largest balance | no |
| a reload on a calendar day on which the card has already been reloaded its most reloads per day | no |
| the first reload on a new calendar day after a day at the daily figure | yes, the count restarts each calendar day |

## Illustration (hypothetical card)

A Northgate Reloadable Gift Card whose balance reached zero is depleted. A reload in store of an amount at or above the smallest reload, and not taking the balance above the largest balance, loads the value and returns the card to active status.
